dedupe_keys.name: state and provincial road inventory statistics of turkiye devlet ve il yol envanteri kgm

description: The General Directorate of Highways of Türkiye (KGM) publishes state and provincial road inventory statistics under the Official Statistics Programme. Coverage: the national network of motorways, state highways and provincial roads, with tables of road network length by surface type, state roads, provincial roads and both combined, each by year and by province. As of 1 January 2026 the network was 68,517 km: 3,796 km of motorways, 30,789 km of state highways and 33,932 km of provincial roads, split into asphalt concrete, surface treatment, stone block, stabilised, earth and primitive roads. Format and access: bilingual Turkish and English PDF tables linked from the KGM statistics page. Licence and cost: free; no licence stated. Caveats: aggregate lengths only, without geometry; bridge and tunnel inventories are not in the tables read. The tables can be used to set network size and surface mix in national road network flow models and to check OpenStreetMap-derived networks. It relates to the KGM Traffic and Transportation Survey of Highways in the catalogue.
